teach.narration_en: Al-Kawthar — 'Abundance.' The shortest surah in the Quran, just three ayat, and one of the first many memorize after Al-Ikhlas. Full recitation now, same as last lesson — tajweed slips get a gentle note, not a fail.
teach.focus_en: Surah Al-Kawthar, ayah by ayah — full recitation, tajweed errors softened.
